description.value: KINTON RAMEN Victoria Downtown is a Japanese ramen chain restaurant situated on Wharf Street in Victoria's Inner Harbour, surrounded by waterfront views and local attractions. Part of one of the largest ramen chains in North America with over 50 locations across Canada and the US, it serves customizable ramen bowls with a choice of pork, beef, chicken, or vegetarian broth. A touring cyclist finishing a ride along the waterfront will find a warm, casual sit-down meal with online ordering also available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 39m; rack (20 spaces) at 40m; rack at 69m; rack (12 spaces) at 80m. Total: 40 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kintonramen.com/victoria-downtown confirms the OSM address (813 Wharf St, Victoria, BC, V8W 1T2) and shows an actively operating restaurant with current promotions running into 2026. The About page explicitly states 'vegetarian options' and the menu confirms a Veggie soup base and veggie protein option. The location page includes an 'Order Online' button confirming takeout/online ordering; no website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant in a high-traffic waterfront location; useful stop for touring cyclists in Victoria's Inner Harbour.
